g1-implement.title: Frozen harness: normalization frame + held-out split + x4 floor reproduction: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Build the metric foundation the whole model is judged on, FROZEN before any layer exists. New package src/physics/weekend_state/: (a) frame.py — load session_estimates (session_type='Q', fit_status='ok') from the ABSOLUTE main-checkout path into a tidy per-(year,gp_name,constructor,round_idx,axis) frame over the 11 axes + their _sigma; (b) floor.py — a faithful re-implementation of x4's exact metric (field_sigma = median over weekends (>=6 constructors) of cross-constructor SD; noise_sd = median over car-seasons (>=4 ok weekends) of within-car-season SD around season mean; N_weekends=(noise_sd/field_sigma)^2; snr) parameterizable to run on ANY normalized value column, not just raw; (c) holdout.py — a DETERMINISTIC frozen weekend held-out split (e.g. hold out every Nth round by a fixed rule / hashed (year,round)), documented, ensuring >= a few held-out weekends per car-season so within-car-season SD is computable on held-out; (d) gate_spec.py — the FROZEN F6 decision rule as code+constants, authored BEFORE any layer/held-out numbers are seen. Fold the cold-critic fixes (PLAN_CRITIC_DISPOSITIONS.md) IN HERE: [F2] the gate compares model-vs-floor on the IDENTICAL held-out weekends, paired per car-season — provide a paired-comparison harness that recomputes the raw x4 floor on any given held-out weekend subset (the 624 full-sample table is only the reproduction/sanity target, NOT the comparison denominator). [F1] a SIGNAL-PRESERVATION guard: score a fitted model's held-out car-signal by its OUT-OF-SAMPLE residual around the train-fit trajectory (so an over-shrinker that emits a near-constant per car-season is punished by large held-out residual on developing cars), NOT by its own self-dispersion; PASS requires faster convergence AND preserved held-out accuracy. [F3] PIN: PASS rule = model beats the paired held-out raw floor on >=7/11 axes by a margin OUTSIDE NOISE, with the noise margin from a bootstrap whose RESAMPLING UNIT is the car-season, tie = not-a-beat; the median convergence-speed ratio across axes is the reported summary (both named in the launch order); include an MDE/power sanity check on the chosen split. Regression-lock: a test reproduces the 624-phase0-baseline-lock x4 floor table (all 11 axes, rel & abs noise_sd + N_weekends) within a tight numeric tolerance, proving floor.py IS x4's metric; a second test asserts gate_spec.py's decision rule + bootstrap are deterministic and frozen (fixed seed). Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF; cite x4 script + 624 doc + store schema + PLAN_CRITIC_DISPOSITIONS exactly. Dispatch constellation-implementer. Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g2-implement.title: Layer 1 explained physics (density from measured pressure + mass/fuel) with sigma: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Build src/physics/weekend_state/layer1_physics.py: the deterministic-ish explained-physics layer. Density from MEASURED per-session pressure via src.utils.environment.moist_air_density_from_pressure (Pa: multiply FastF1 mbar by 100; use the store's rho where already measured, but the layer's density path must be the measured-pressure one, NOT fixed RHO=1.2, NOT the buggy altitude lookup). Model how density (a shared per-weekend systematic on the ρ-bearing axes — drag/power channels) and mass/fuel (mass_kg_assumed) explain a computable, removable component of each axis reading; produce the explained component + a RESIDUAL (axis minus explained physics) per car-weekend, each carrying an explicit sigma (propagate pressure/measurement + model uncertainty). Density SECONDARY CHECK (F6 secondary) — must be FALSIFIABLE, not confirmatory-by-construction (cold-critic F6): show the density layer EXPLAINS a known cross-track difference — Mexico (high altitude -> low measured pressure -> low ρ) vs Monaco (sea level -> high ρ). Implement it as a RESIDUAL-CONSISTENCY test with a numeric tolerance: after density removal, the SAME car's drag/power residual at Mexico vs Monaco must AGREE within its propagated σ (a real pass/fail with a failure mode), NOT merely 'ρ was divided out'. Acknowledge the aero/setup confound (Mexico differs from Monaco in trim + track, not only density) so a residual gap is not naively blamed on density. Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF citing environment.moist_air_density_from_pressure signature + density memory (measured Pressure, altitude lookup buggy, log-space for multiplicative). Dispatch implementer. Integrate result.

g3-implement.title: Layer 2 within-session evolution grip latent with sigma + identifiability test: implement
g3-implement.imperative: Build src/physics/weekend_state/layer2_evolution.py: a SMOOTH grip latent over session time capturing track rubbering-in (the F9 foot-gun a weekend-constant median hides), carrying sigma. IDENTIFIABILITY CRUX (DC1, sharpened by cold-critic F5): session_estimates is one Q row/car-weekend with no within-session timing, so build the latent from a genuinely WITHIN-SESSION signal — damage_integrals.db:grip_bin_obs mu_lat_p90/mu_comb_p90 vs cumulative_track_laps/tyre_life (a real within-session grip-evolution curve), EXPLICITLY acknowledging the race-vs-Q domain gap (grip_bin_obs is race-session-weighted; within-race rubbering differs from a short Q session — state the assumption, do not paper over it). CRITICAL (F5): a 'season-time smooth track/conditions latent' is NOT a valid Layer-2 analog — that is Layer 3's own trajectory axis, and filling L2 with it double-counts L3. If the ONLY reachable signal is season-time, DECLARE Layer 2 unidentifiable-at-this-granularity and FLOAT to the Admiral (report the held-out evidence) — do NOT fill it with a season-time latent. Model the within-session latent as a smooth latent (GP or penalized spline) over session time with honest sigma. HONEST TEST (mandatory): (1) whether removing this layer reduces held-out car-signal noise via OUT-OF-SAMPLE / LOO prediction (lesson:loo-residual-diagnostic — a self-weighted smoother pins predictions to their own value and is blind to the σ-over-claim it must detect); (2) an ORTHOGONALITY check that the L2 latent is not collinear with the L3 season trajectory (else it is confounded, not identified). If the layer cannot be identified / cannot earn its keep on held-out data, REPORT that with the held-out numbers (verdict finding + float per Pre-Ruling 2), do NOT silently drop it and do NOT fake an in-sample win. Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF citing grip_bin_obs schema + absolute path + LOO discipline. Dispatch implementer. Integrate result.

g4-implement.title: Layer 3 field-car common-mode (relative + smooth re-anchor) + Layer 4 car signal, with sigma: implement
g4-implement.imperative: Build src/physics/weekend_state/layer3_fieldcar.py + layer4_car.py + model.py (the four-layer assembler). Layer 3 = cake-and-eat-it two-stage: (a) RELATIVE = car minus that weekend's field median on the layer-1/2-residualized axis (resolves fast); (b) RE-ANCHOR — fit a SMOOTH field-car ABSOLUTE trajectory per axis over the season so absolute development still accrues; REUSE src/physics/layer2/pooling.py (PooledParameter, DerSimonian-Laird random-effects tau^2 + weighted_trend) for the field-car trajectory + partial-pooling shrinkage — cite its exact signatures in the handoff. Both stages carry sigma. Layer 4 = car signal = the shrunk/partial-pooled deltas off the field car (the quantity the F6 gate measures). model.py composes L1->L2->L3->L4 into a decomposed per-car-weekend state with a per-layer sigma each. The car-signal must be computable on a held-out weekend using ONLY hyperparameters fit on train weekends (no leakage). Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF citing pooling.py signatures. Dispatch implementer. Integrate result.

g5-implement.title: F6 held-out gate + writeup: implement
g5-implement.imperative: Build src/physics/weekend_state/gate_f6.py: apply the g1 FROZEN gate_spec (do NOT re-derive the decision rule here — import it) to the four-layer model's OUTPUT car-signal, on the g1 FROZEN held-out weekend split (hyperparameters fit on TRAIN weekends only, no leakage). [F2] Recompute the raw x4 floor on the IDENTICAL held-out weekends and compare model-vs-floor PAIRED per car-season (not against the 624 full-sample table). [F1] Score the model's held-out car-signal with the frozen signal-preservation guard (out-of-sample residual around the train-fit trajectory), so an over-shrinker cannot win. Produce the per-axis table: model held-out convergence-speed vs the paired held-out floor; count how many of 11 axes beat the floor by a margin outside the frozen car-season bootstrap noise. [F4] Also run a held-out LEAVE-ONE-LAYER-OUT ablation (Δ convergence with/without each of the 4 layers) so each layer's marginal contribution is reported and no dead layer is credited. VERDICT computed by the frozen rule: PASS iff >=7/11 held-out axes beat the paired floor by a margin outside noise AND held-out accuracy is preserved; else DID-NOT-BEAT-FLOOR (honest null). Write docs/physics/626-phase2-weekend-state-model.md (the four layers, each layer's sigma, how L2 within-session evolution + L3 cake-and-eat-it work, the F6 held-out result table + verdict + noise margin, the per-layer ablation, the Mexico-vs-Monaco density secondary check, and any honest-null/float) and docs/physics/626-f6-holdout-gate.json (machine-readable per-axis result + ablation). A test asserts the gate harness runs end-to-end and emits a verdict (PASS or DID-NOT-BEAT-FLOOR) with the per-axis table + ablation — the test does NOT require a PASS (honest-null is a valid completion). Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF. Dispatch implementer. Integrate result.
